name: Basilic Fly Studio Ltd.
summary: Basilic Fly Studio Ltd. operates as a visual effects (VFX) studio, providing high-end VFX solutions and post-production services primarily for the media and entertainment industry. Its services encompass rotoscopy, previsualization, camera and body tracking, rotomation, object tracking, computer graphics, paint and preparation, compositing, and on-set supervision. The company specializes in delivering VFX for movies, television shows, web series, and commercials. Headquartered in Chennai, India, Basilic Fly Studio serves a global market, with subsidiaries in the UK and Canada, and offices in Pune and Vancouver. The company works with both major global VFX studios and directly with production houses, including clients like Apple TV+, Marvel, Paramount, Netflix, Amazon, and Warner Bros. Pictures. Basilic Fly Studio is also expanding its operations into the gaming VFX sector.
